source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any of your units with this ability makes a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, each of its models takes a **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)**, with -1 to each test if that unit is [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) too. **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES** are exempt.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more friendly units with this ability

effect.desperateEscapeTests: every model in the enemy unit
